name: Band Lying Hip Internal Rotation
steps: Lie face down beside a low band anchor with one knee bent 90 degrees and the band pulling that ankle inward.
Keep the front of your pelvis and thigh resting flat against the floor.
Swing your lower leg smoothly outward away from your midline against the band to internally rotate your hip.
Return your foot slowly back toward the anchor, then reposition and switch sides after finishing one leg.
tips: Keep both hip bones flat on the floor rather than rolling your pelvis as your shin swings.
Move through a comfortable hip range without forcing knee discomfort.
